notes: Vitrina (MKD) already counted. Thinker POS (thinkerpos.com, Skopje) is a new food-truck-page POS priced in MKD whose food-truck page says customers can 'pre-order and pick up'. Two doubts for the reviewer: (1) its pricing page never says which plan includes online ordering — Standard/Advanced include a choosable 'Takeaway & delivery license' and 'Basic + Website' says '*Does not include ecommerce'; I recorded Standard 6,295 and Advanced 8,693 MKD/month incl. VAT; (2) its English product pages are written as 'Ecash' ('Ecash POS comes packaged with features tailored for food truck operations.'), apparently template text from another product. If both are accepted the count is 2; otherwise 1. Not opened (EUR prices in the snippets, so they cannot count): eBar (ebar.mk, € packages), EasyOffer (easyoffer.mk, from €13), Order This / Antoris (€50–100, QR), Facturino (retail POS), Accent easyPOS (2,500 ден/month but only Wolt order sync in the snippet), Shopwidget (Serbian, €25, generic widget — read for BA), restaurantmanage.com (QR room service), Restorani.mk (directory). Not re-read: FoxiFood (EUR only), Naracaj, Klikni Jadi.
